description:
REMIRA INSTORE App

Making in-store processes simple and ensuring a smooth omnichannel customer experience

The REMIRA INSTORE App offers in-store retailers comprehensive functions as a springboard to a digital business model, from customer consultation on the shop floor to backroom inventory management.

Functions at a glance:

Take your storefront online: With the omnichannel services Click & Reserve and Click & Collect, you can connect your brick-and-mortar store with your digital presence as a web shop online. Customers can order products online and have the goods delivered to the store to try on or to take home with them.

Omnichannel in-store: By integrating Click & Collect and Click & Reserve, your sales staff has contact with your online customers, creating the opportunity to generate additional sales on site through cross-selling or upselling.

Record incoming goods digitally: Sales staff can scan delivery note numbers, record suppliers, barcodes, and quantities and can then forward the data to the backend.

Supplier returns: User-friendly digital process for returning goods to the supplier

Stock transfer made easy: Items on a delivery note do not have to be recorded one at a time for stock transfer to another store. All you need to do is scan the delivery note number! We also support stock transfers without notification of dispatch. Simply straightforward stock transfer.

Requesting goods across stores for customers: Does your customer want a product in a size that you no longer have in stock, but your neighboring store does? No problem! The REMIRA INSTORE App provides a custom menu that allows your sales staff to request goods from other stores for each particular customer - including delivery tracking up to your store’s doorstep. The sales staff can inform the customer by SMS, e-mail, or telephone when the product is ready for pickup.

A filter concept for better results: With the new filter concept, stock data can be clearly selected and honed in on. The filter criteria "Date", "Supplier", "Color" or "Size" provide you with the matches you are looking for in your stock data.

- Make inventory scanning even more straightforward: Your employees can scan so-called location/place barcodes using the camera on their smartphone or an additional scanning device to scan for inventory where it is needed. Manual entry is also possible. Correcting quantities in your data entry or deleting the entire inventory set is also just a swipe away.

- Made for both online and offline: Can’t connect to your ERP backend for some reason? You can carry out your entire inventory in an offline mode. The data is stored locally until it can be transferred the next time online.

Customer management: Customer data can also be recorded in the REMIRA INSTORE App. Put your customers in control and let them enter their customer data in store with the app’s very own interactive kiosk mode.

ListKin is a shared grocery list and family shopping list in one simple app. Everyone in the household adds to the same shopping list and sees each change live, at home or in the store. No sign up, it works offline, and when you run out of dinner ideas, Sprout, the AI helper, suggests meals and adds what to buy.

One shared shopping list for the family

Create a household and invite your family, partner or roommates with a simple join code. Everyone sees the same grocery list as it changes: add milk at home and it shows up on the phone of whoever is at the supermarket. Tick it off in the store and the rest of the family sees that too. ListKin can tell you when someone adds or removes something, and you can turn that off.

Add items in seconds

Type a few letters and pick from suggestions, or type several items at once with commas. Quick add puts what you typed straight on the list. Your usual items stay one tap away, so the weekly shop mostly builds itself. Share text from any app onto the list too. Or tap the mic and say it: milk, eggs and bread go on as three items.

Several lists, one household

Keep separate lists for groceries, the pharmacy or a party, and tap a list's tab on the add page to add there. With ListKin Pro, see every list, or the ones you choose, at once on one screen and on the widget.

No sign up, works offline

Open the app and start your list. No account, no email, nothing to fill in. Make an account later if you want the same list on a second phone. ListKin keeps working with no signal, at the back of the store or in the basement car park, and syncs the moment you are back online.

Plan meals with AI

Ask for dinner ideas, a recipe for six, or a week of quick lunches. Sprout answers with the ingredients, sorted and ticked, and adds them to your grocery list in one tap. It knows what is already on the list, so you do not buy the same thing twice. The AI helper is free, with a daily allowance of messages.

Turn a photo into a list

Snap a recipe, a handwritten note or the inside of your fridge, and Sprout turns it into items on your shopping list. No more retyping the list from the fridge door. Photo to list is part of ListKin Pro.

Prices with a built in calculator

Add a price as you shop and ListKin keeps a running total of the grocery list. The number pad does the sums for you, so 3 x 1.25 or a multibuy is one entry. Pick your household currency once.

Keep every receipt

When you finish shopping, save the trip as a slip with its date, items and total. Edit it later, share it as an image or save it to your gallery. Your slips are grouped by month, so you can see what you spent this month at a glance and keep a grocery budget without a spreadsheet.

Sorted the way your store is

Turn on aisle sorting and the list follows the way you walk the store, in the order you set once. Add a note to an item for the brand or the size.

On your home screen

The widget is a little receipt on your home screen with every item still to buy. It scrolls, and you can make its text bigger in Settings to read it in the shop. A second widget adds an item in one tap.

Made for every kitchen

ListKin speaks 44 languages, follows your phone's light or dark mode, and works on any Android phone.

ListKin Pro

An optional subscription, and one Pro covers your whole household: everyone gets all lists at once, more lists, activity history and photo to list. You also get unlimited AI messages, every Sprout chat kept, more households and extra colour themes. Try it free for 3 days. Everything free stays free.

Questions

Is ListKin free? Yes. The shared grocery list, live sync, prices, receipts and the widget are free; ListKin Pro adds more.

How do I share my grocery list with family? Create a household and send the join code. Everyone sees the same shopping list.

Does it work offline? Yes. Add and tick items with no signal, and it syncs when you are back online.

Start your family's shared grocery list today and shop together.

Amazon helps users in India handle daily shopping and common mobile tasks from one place. It suits people who want to buy products, pay bills, order groceries, follow deliveries, and watch short videos without switching between many apps. In addition, the Amazon app brings order management, offers, payment options, and customer support into the same mobile experience, so users can move from browsing to checkout and tracking with fewer steps.


Shopping Across Daily Categories

Browse products for home and personal use

Amazon lets you shop across many categories, including mobiles, electronics, fashion, beauty, books, home appliances, kitchen products, groceries, and household essentials. This makes the Amazon shopping app download useful for users who buy both planned items and regular needs from an Android phone. After choosing a category, you can compare products, check details, and move to checkout inside the same app.

Use Amazon Pay for bills and transfers

Amazon Pay supports payments, UPI transfers, recharges, bill payments, flight bookings, wallet balance use, and faster refunds. You can also use pay on delivery where it is available, which helps when you prefer to pay after the order reaches you. Because these payment tools sit inside Amazon, users can manage shopping and regular payments in one flow.

Track orders and manage returns

Amazon shows order updates, delivery notifications, and tracking details after a purchase is placed. You can follow where an order is in the delivery process and check expected delivery information from the app. If an eligible item needs attention after delivery, Amazon also supports returns and replacements, along with 24 hour customer service support.

Find deals and Prime benefits

Amazon includes offers, deals, Lightning deals, app benefits, and Prime perks on eligible products. You can check deal sections before buying, then decide whether a price or delivery option fits your needs. For Prime users, free delivery and early deal access may appear on eligible items, so it is worth checking the product page before checkout.

Order groceries and watch miniTV

Amazon Fresh, Pantry, and grocery delivery services cover items such as vegetables, snacks, beverages, personal care products, and household supplies. This helps users add daily essentials to the same app used for other shopping. When shopping is done, Amazon miniTV offers free entertainment such as web series, short films, comedy videos, miniMovies, watchlists, and continue watching support.


What To Know About Amazon India

Amazon is designed here as an India focused mobile app, so services such as Amazon Pay UPI, Fresh, Pantry, miniTV, cash on delivery, and local deals are central to the experience. Availability can depend on the product, delivery address, payment method, and eligible service area, so users should review details shown in the app before placing an order.

The Amazon APK is useful for users who want the same app to cover shopping, payments, groceries, offers, rewards, games, Alexa voice shopping, and order help. However, each section serves a different purpose, so the best experience comes from using the search bar, category pages, account menu, and order section together rather than treating Amazon only as a product catalog.


How To Use Amazon On Android

After installing the Amazon latest version, open the app and sign in with your account details. The home screen gives access to shopping categories, Amazon Pay, groceries, miniTV, deals, and order tools, so you can begin with the task you need first.

  1. Open Amazon and choose a section from the home screen, such as shopping, Amazon Pay, Fresh, Pantry, miniTV, or deals.
  2. Search for a product or service, then review the available details, price, delivery information, payment choices, and any eligible offer shown on the page.
  3. Add selected products to the cart or continue with a payment, recharge, bill, UPI transfer, or booking through Amazon Pay.
  4. Confirm the address and payment option, then place the order or complete the payment when the information is correct.
  5. Use the order section to check tracking updates, delivery notifications, returns, replacements, refunds, or customer service support when needed.


Start With Amazon

Amazon brings shopping, Amazon Pay, grocery ordering, delivery tracking, deals, miniTV entertainment, and support tools into one Android app for users in India. To manage these tasks from one place, download Amazon and use the sections that match your daily needs.

description:
Package Delivery Tracker replaces the scatter of confirmation emails with a single arrival board you control.

For every order, save the carrier (UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS, Amazon, or other), the tracking ID, the expected delivery date, the current status (label created, in transit, out for delivery, delivered, or exception), and where it is headed — home, office, or a pickup locker. The queue sorts by urgency so today's arrivals and overdue packages surface first, with an active-deliveries count at the top.

MADE FOR HEAVY ORDERING SEASONS

- Holiday shopping: a dozen open orders across four shops stay one glance apart.

- Split shipments: each box gets its own line, so a half-arrived order is obvious.

- Exceptions: flag a stuck package and it stays visible until resolved instead of drowning in email.

- Locker pickups: destination labels remind you which deliveries still need a trip.

PRINT THE QUEUE

One tap sends the current delivery board — tracking IDs, carriers, statuses, dates, destinations — to Android print services. Handy as a household fridge list or for an office mailroom.

STRAIGHT ABOUT HOW IT WORKS

This app is a deliberate manual log: it does not connect to carrier systems and does not auto-refresh statuses. You update a package when you get news; the app keeps the overview clean, sorted, and always available. In exchange, it needs no account, asks for no access to your email, and never sends your purchase activity anywhere.

FULLY OFFLINE, FULLY PRIVATE

Everything is stored on your device. No sign-in, no cloud, no advertising profile built from what you buy. It opens instantly, works in airplane mode, and is exactly as private as a paper list — but sorted, searchable, and always in your pocket when the doorbell rings.

Stop re-opening five shop apps to answer one question. Put every open order on one board and know, at a glance, what is arriving today.
